page_title: ROM 3-1 UDI | AS Roma v Udinese 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick. Martin Payero (Udinese) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
90+3' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' 3 - 1 Goal! Edoardo Bove plays a long ball to Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the top right corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 3:1.
89' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
86' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:2.
84' Isaac Success (Udinese) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
83' Jose Mourinho decides to make a substitution. Paulo Dybala will be replaced by Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma).
83' Here's the change. Jordan Zemura leaves the pitch and Hassane Kamara (Udinese) comes on as a substitute.

80' 2 - 1 Brilliant finish! Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Romelu Lukaku, then produced a nice strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:1.
79' We are about to witness a subsitution. Christian Kabasele (Udinese) for Joao Ferreira.
79' Gabriele Cioffi has decided to make a change. Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) replaces Florian Thauvin.
77' Here is a change. Leandro Paredes is going off and Jose Mourinho gives the last tactical orders to Edoardo Bove (AS Roma).
77' The referee allows time for a substitution. Rick Karsdorp will be replaced by Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma).

77' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
75' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from AS Roma.
73' Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
72' Martin Payero (Udinese) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
70' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. AS Roma will have a throw-in.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lazar Samardzic leaves the pitch and Sandi Lovric (Udinese) comes on.
67' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
67' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
66' The number of offsides is – 0:0.
63' Jose Mourinho has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) replacing Lorenzo Pellegrini.
63' Here comes a substitution. Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Leonardo Spinazzola.
62' AS Roma are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
61' AS Roma are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
57' 1 - 1 Goal! Florian Thauvin (Udinese) makes the score 1:1 after burying a close-range header in the bottom left corner after a good run and cross by Martin Payero.
57' AS Roma enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
55' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
55' The ball possession at the moment is 70:30.
54' Walace (Udinese) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Rui Patricio makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
52' The AS Roma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
51' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
50' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma), but it's just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
49' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) will deliver the corner kick.

49' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.

47' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is quickest inside the box and jumps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
47' There's an opportunity for Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
46' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to AS Roma.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Luca Massimi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' A quickly taken corner by AS Roma.
43' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee blows his whistle, AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
42' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
41' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
40' Neat passing move from Udinese in order to create new attacking opportunities.
39' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 5:7.
38' AS Roma control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
35' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) finds Paulo Dybala with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
33' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
33' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
32' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
31' Total attempts – 3:1.
28' Isaac Success (Udinese) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
26' Booking. Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) receives a caution from the referee.
25' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
24' Great teamplay by AS Roma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

20' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Paulo Dybala flights the free kick into the box, where Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) peels off his marker and heads straight into the left side of the net from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:0.
19' This is a yellow card! Joao Ferreira (Udinese) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
18' A spell of possession for Udinese in an attempt to control the game.
18' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:0.
16' The AS Roma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
15' None of the AS Roma players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
14' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) sends a long ball forward to Isaac Success, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
12' The possession of the ball – 64:36.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.
7' The Udinese players are exchanging some short passes.
6' A cross by Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
6' AS Roma string together a series of short passes.
3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from AS Roma.
1' An attempted cross from Festy Ebosele (Udinese) is cleared.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Udinese will take the kick-off.
